contract: AC-001 Given/When/Then match the lint's actual behavior: nine required characteristics enforced against characteristics.yaml, measurable/score coherence, and the Sources-examined host allowlist.
design: Policy (characteristics.yaml), research (quality-standards.md) and the lint are decoupled; the r6 tab guard isolates the TSV reserialization from the typed-failure surface.
compatibility: No consumer-facing contract changes; scope confined to the card's five owned paths; the r6->r7 delta touches only the acceptance script's Sources loop.
tests: MUT-001 (score on measurable:false -> score-without-signal), MUT-002 (host substitution -> unversioned-source), tab-injection (malformed-entry) and missing-characteristic all re-executed from scratch with byte-identical restoration.
security: Sources verified live: arc42 and SARM corroborate the three characteristic changes (Usability->Interaction capability, Portability->Flexibility, Safety added); the ISO page 403-bot-blocked, recorded as inconclusive with two independent secondary sources confirming; canary absent from outputs.
concurrency: Static policy/data lint with a single-shot read-only pass; no concurrent or retried execution path is introduced.
errors-operations: Every failure branch emits a typed code via the single fail() sink; symlinked research doc is rejected fail-closed (behavior-missing); set -euo pipefail with no producer-exit-masking pipe on the decision path.
documentation: docs/specs/AUR-016.md documents behavior, contract, limits and diagnostics; the stale mention of a sort dependency was recorded as a non-blocking doc inconsistency after r6 removed the unused tool.
scope-simplicity: Non-goals honored: the lint stays a pure read/verify pass; the old 5-line stub was strictly strengthened, never weakened.
hunks: All hunks of the r6 candidate against 5729803e were read; the r7 delta (16 insertions, 5 deletions in the accept script) reviewed hunk by hunk in the re-seal.

contract: The r6 veto was the contract check working: the Sources allowlist validated only the leftmost [label](url) per cell, so an appended non-allowlisted link passed with nominal stdout; r7 loops over every occurrence and the exact bypass now fails typed unversioned-source.
design: The r7 fix walks the cell tail with match()/substr() emitting a typed failure for any non-allowlisted host anywhere in the cell; no eval, no dynamic code path.
compatibility: r7 changes only tests/acceptance/AUR-016.sh; fixtures and policy files untouched, verified by the patch's single-file diffstat.
tests: The exact r6 bypass, the 3-link variant, links on different rows, an unclosed malformed link, two bad links in one cell, inverted order and no-space adjacency all fail typed; MUT-001/MUT-002/tab-injection/missing-characteristic regressions clean.
security: Hostile-input probes: tab injection caught before the TSV join; pipe-character injection trips the link-pattern check; symlink substitution rejected; AURUM_SECRET_CANARY absent from stdout+stderr.
concurrency: Single deterministic process, no shared mutable state, no retries.
errors-operations: The r5 tab-class veto proved malformed input could not desynchronize silently anymore: any tab in a YAML field or Sources cell is a typed malformed-entry before any scoring logic runs.
documentation: The acceptance script's own comments name the tab vector and the multi-link rule; diagnostics reproduced live in the re-seal.
scope-simplicity: The fix is 16 insertions/5 deletions confined to the Sources loop; every added line maps to a re-executed proof.
hunks: All hunks of r6 and the r7 delta read with adversarial priority on the parsing and allowlist paths.
